verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise page claims "Programmatic queries via API" and a way to integrate it into other workflows. It also exposes a remote HTTP MCP endpoint (https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp) that a CLI agent such as Claude Code can add, which suggests non-interactive use is possible. However, the API looks enterprise-gated, no public API spec or reference was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and nothing shows actual headless or CI usage. Missing for 10: public API documentation, auth/token setup for unattended runs, explicit headless/CI usage docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
